notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Ardent Elementalist and Peregrine Drake
When Ardent Elementalist and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
